intro_line: Almaty: apple orchards, snow peaks, and leafy Soviet boulevards.
intro: Almaty rewards visitors with mountain trails, café culture, and grand old squares within a short ride of each other. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
transit_facts: Metro: one line, open 06:00-00:00, 120 tenge per trip, contactless cards accepted at gates.
Buses: about 170 routes plus trolleybuses; cash fare 200 tenge, Onay card fare 120 tenge.
Onay card costs 800 tenge at караван newsstands; top up at Qiwi terminals, cash only.
Yandex Go is the main ride app; airport rides around 1500 tenge, but watch for fare scams.
Driving is busy and parking is hard; walking is easy in the centre, with gentle slopes toward the mountains.
Bikes and scooters are rentable by app; Yandex Go scooters run about 50 tenge per minute.

airports.name: Almaty International Airport
airports.note: Main gateway for Central Asia, 15 km northeast of the centre.

options.note: About 400 m walk from Arrivals to the Mailin St stop.
Skips downtown; useful for onward buses.
Book at the arrivals booth or via Yandex Go; agree the total price first.
Fixed app price avoids the per-kilometre scam.
